accueil.titre: Dating that starts with what you share.
accueil.intro: LoveMatch works out how compatible you are with each profile (age, distance, interests, languages spoken, intentions) and shows you the breakdown. Born in Madagascar, open to the world: 31,000 towns, seven languages, for people aged 18 and over.
accueil.exempleLegende: Example of a suggested profile with its compatibility score
accueil.calculTitre: A score woven from five strands
accueil.calculIntro: Every suggestion shows its score out of 100 and how much each criterion adds. The score is the same both ways: your score with someone is also their score with you.
accueil.brin.age: The closer your ages are to the middle of each other’s preferred range, the fuller this strand.
accueil.brin.distance: Measured between your two towns, never from your exact location.
accueil.brin.interets: The share of what you both like, out of everything either of you likes.
accueil.brin.recherche: Something serious, friendship or seeing where it goes: wanting the same thing counts too.
accueil.regle.mutuel: Your criteria work both ways: you only see people who are looking for someone like you.
accueil.regle.vieprivee: Your surname and email address are never shown to other members.
accueil.regle.message: Nobody can message you without a mutual like. Blocking someone closes the conversation for good.
accueil.regle.majeur: For people aged 18 and over only. Every report is read by the moderators.
accueil.pied: LoveMatch, a project by Juliot JERA (ESMIA). Demo profiles are fictional and their portraits are drawings.

conf.sous: What LoveMatch stores, what others see, and how to erase everything.
conf.collecte.texte: Your email, your password (hashed, unreadable even by the team), your first name and surname, your date of birth, your gender, your town, your profile, your photos, your likes, your matches and your messages.
conf.visible.texte: Your first name, age, town, bio, interests, languages, what you are looking for and your photos. Never your surname, your email or your exact date of birth.
conf.photos.texte: They are resized and saved again by the server, which removes hidden information from the file (where it was taken, which device). Only signed-in members can view them.
conf.distance.texte: Distance is calculated between the centre of your town and the other member’s. LoveMatch never asks for your location.
conf.messages.texte: Only the two people in a match can read their conversation. Moderators only see a message if it is reported to them.
conf.effacement.texte: From your profile, “Delete my account” immediately erases your account, photos, likes, matches and messages.
conf.cookies.texte: Only two technical cookies: your session (unreadable by the browser) and protection against forged requests. No advertising or analytics cookies.
introuvable.texte: The link may be incomplete, or the page has moved.
langues.aide: From 1 to 5. You need at least one language in common to be suggested to each other.
accueil.brin.langues: At least one shared language is required; two or more gives full points.
